name: 东方故事 — esI（"屠龙之战"）
english_description: Another build of "Eastern Story," themed around an in-game event called the Dragon Slaying War. Shares nearly identical core code with es1_win (Eastern Story: Blue Sky) from this same engine family, differing mainly in site content and branch details. This particular snapshot ships with a test-era configuration that grants new characters automatic wizard privileges, suggesting it was originally used for internal testing or load trials rather than public play.
